parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of a display, primarily made of glass with a plastic or metal frame around it.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output from a computer or other device, serving as the main interface for viewing content.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed to the stand but can tilt slightly depending on the mount design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic, providing stability and support for the screen.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the screen and maintains balance on a flat surface, sometimes allowing tilt or rotation.
parts.Movement_description: The base itself remains stationary, though it may allow the screen to pivot or tilt around its joint.
